script_text: Sagittarius, fire sign ruled by Jupiter, this week could change love and income. Early week, Mercury in Virgo in 10th House sextile Saturn in Taurus in 6th House favors contracts and money talks; Thursday is favorable for decisions. Venus square Pluto in Aquarius in your 2nd House makes Friday worst, when attraction, debt, or control can shake trust. In love, Jupiter in Cancer in your 8th House deepens intimacy. Sunday marks turning point: Uranus in Gemini in your 7th House trines Pluto in Aquarius, exposing what must change. Monday and Tuesday, Saturn sextile Neptune in Pisces turns insight into budgets. Wednesday is best for career momentum, while Saturday favors intimate conversation. Your best day is Wednesday because disciplined 10th House communication opens opportunity. Your worst day is Friday because Venus square Pluto magnifies pressure. Keep money talks factual and request commitment. Follow for daily updates.
